snippet.title: SUBMIND – Official Game Teaser | Inoutbox
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4237670/Submind/

Dive into broken minds, with up to 3 friends, in order to stabilize them. Pick the correct path, solve puzzles, pay attention to your surroundings, all while making sure the patient's mind doesn't go to the point of no return, because if does, you'll be facing their worse traumas and nightmares.
